reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Required recitals and contents of articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Requires caption citing chapter, signatures of at least five incorporators, and specific details including name, office, term, and first directors.

headings.title: Submission of articles to secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Requires submission of executed articles of incorporation to the secretary of state for filing under this chapter.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5392, A.L. 1983 H.B. 137). Confirmed draft titles for cooperative articles of incorporation contents (5+ incorporators) and filing with secretary of state.

headings.title: Requirements and procedures for conversion into cooperative
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth procedure for rural electric corporations to convert to cooperatives via board approval, member or stockholder vote, and filing articles.

headings.title: Definition of articles of incorporation to include conversion
headings.reviewNote: Provides that the statutory term articles of incorporation includes articles of conversion of a converted corporation.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5402). Confirmed draft titles for converting rural electric corporations into cooperatives and defining 'articles of incorporation' to include articles of conversion.

headings.title: Enumerated corporate and operational powers of cooperative
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates 14 general powers including electric generation/transmission, broadband fiber, wiring loans, eminent domain, and post-Aug. 28, 2018 trespass/inverse condemnation valuation rules; footnote notes 'attorney's' appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Retail electric supply conditions in municipalities over 1500
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes retail electric supply post-August 28, 1989 in municipalities over 1,500 population where cooperative was predominant supplier and has franchise.

headings.title: Written notice of franchise application to competitor suppliers
headings.reviewNote: Requires cooperative applying for initial municipal franchise to provide concurrent written notice to all retail electric providers in the municipality.

headings.title: Preservation of municipal franchise authority and utility rights
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that subsections 2 and 3 do not diminish municipal authority to grant franchises or electrical corporations' rights to serve.

headings.title: Commission authority to reassign suppliers in the public interest
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission upon complaint and hearing to order alternative supplier in public interest for non-rate reasons, disclaiming rate and management jurisdiction.

headings.title: Applicability of antitrust provisions
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that cooperative powers under this section and section 394.085 are subject to antitrust provisions in section 416.031.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5388 through A.L. 2018 H.B. 1880; original-rolls footnote 'attorney's' in sub 1(11); ch. 523, §§ 386.805, 227.240 cross-refs). Confirmed all 6 draft titles and added original-rolls footnote to sub 1 note.

headings.title: Legislative declaration regarding high-speed broadband expansion
headings.reviewNote: Declares expanding access to high-speed broadband communications services throughout Missouri a public purpose of great importance.

headings.title: Joint agreements for broadband deployment using electric infrastructure
headings.reviewNote: Expresses legislative intent to facilitate voluntary agreements for using rural electric cooperative infrastructure to provide broadband access.

headings.title: Definition of rural electric cooperative to include electrical corporations
headings.reviewNote: Defines rural electric cooperative for this section to include electrical corporations under section 393.110.2.

headings.title: Public service commission regulatory jurisdiction disclaimer
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section confers no commission regulatory jurisdiction over joint broadband contracts or the parties thereto.

headings.title: Preservation of property owner rights
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that this section does not diminish property owner rights under Missouri law.

headings.title: Mandatory broadband service offer along cooperative fiber route
headings.reviewNote: Requires distribution cooperative providing member broadband to offer service within reasonable time to properties traversed by its broadband fiber.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (L. 2018 H.B. 1880). Confirmed all 6 draft titles for broadband expansion declaration, voluntary infrastructure agreements, electrical corporation inclusion, PSC/property disclaimers, and traversed-property service offer.

headings.title: Procedure for amending articles of incorporation
headings.reviewNote: Requires board approval, two-thirds member vote at meeting, and filing executed articles of amendment and compliance affidavit with secretary of state.

headings.title: Procedure for changing location of principal office
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes changing principal office by majority member vote, filing certificate with secretary of state and county offices, and recording articles.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5398). Confirmed draft titles for two-thirds member articles amendment procedure and majority-vote principal office change.

headings.title: Presentation of articles and affidavits to secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Requires presentation of duplicate executed articles and affidavits for incorporation, amendment, consolidation, merger, conversion, or dissolution.

headings.title: Filing by secretary of state and transmittal to recorder of deeds
headings.reviewNote: Directs secretary of state to file conforming articles upon fee payment, putting action into effect, and transmit certified copies to county recorder.

headings.title: County recording duties and validity preservation
headings.reviewNote: Requires county recorder of deeds to file, record, and index certified copies, providing failure by officials does not invalidate articles.

headings.title: Application to certificates of election to dissolve
headings.reviewNote: Applies section filing and recording provisions to certificates of election to dissolve and affidavits under section 394.240.3(2).

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5404). Confirmed all 4 draft titles for presenting articles to secretary of state, filing/transmittal to county recorder, recording/validity preservation, and certificates of election to dissolve.

headings.title: Membership agreement requirement and non-transferability
headings.reviewNote: Requires agreement to take electric service as membership condition, authorizes bylaw termination for non-use, and restricts transferability.

headings.title: Annual meeting of members
headings.reviewNote: Directs holding an annual meeting of members at such time as provided in the bylaws.

headings.title: Calling of special meetings of members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes calling of special member meetings by board of directors, any three directors, president, or at least ten percent of members.

headings.title: Place of member meetings
headings.reviewNote: Requires member meetings to be held at place provided in bylaws, defaulting to city or town of principal office.

headings.title: Notice of member meetings
headings.reviewNote: Mandates written or printed notice of meeting time, place, and special purpose given personally or by mail ten to twenty-five days prior.

headings.title: Quorum requirements for member meetings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes quorum as two percent of first 2,000 members and one percent of remainder, allowing electronic or mail participation if bylaws provide.

headings.title: Voting rights, proxy limits, and remote voting methods
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees one vote per member in person or by proxy, mail, or electronic voting if bylaws allow, capping individual proxy voting at two members.

headings.title: Temporary board authority for meeting time, place, and voting
headings.reviewNote: Conferred board authority to set meeting time, place, virtual format, and remote voting methods, with statutory expiration on August 28, 2022.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 8 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5394 through A.L. 2021 H.B. 734/S.B. 44; footnote notes sub 8 expires 8-28-22). Confirmed all 8 draft titles.

headings.title: Board management, member qualifications, and compensation limits
headings.reviewNote: Requires management by at least 5 cooperative members, bylaw regulation of elections/removal, and prohibits director salaries absent member approval; source note cites Triplett v. Grundy Electric Cooperative (1965).

headings.title: Initial directors term of office
headings.reviewNote: Provides that directors named in articles hold office until the next annual meeting or until successors are elected and qualify.

headings.title: Staggered terms for three classes of directors
headings.reviewNote: Requires dividing directors into three equal classes with staggered three-year terms elected at successive annual meetings.

headings.title: Board quorum
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that a majority of the board of directors constitutes a quorum.

headings.title: Joint membership director eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Allows either husband or wife holding joint membership, but not both, to be elected as a director.

headings.title: Exercise of cooperative powers by board
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board of directors to exercise all cooperative powers except those reserved to members by law, articles, or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5395; 1965 Triplett v. Grundy Electric Cooperative annotation on member-approved director salaries). Confirmed all 6 draft titles and added annotation to sub 1 note.

headings.title: Commission safety jurisdiction over line construction and duplication
headings.reviewNote: Subjects lines to commission safety and interference rules and duplication minimization, while disclaiming jurisdiction over rates, financing, and management.

headings.title: Commission proceedings, notices, and review
headings.reviewNote: Directs that commission applications, hearings, orders, and judicial review follow standard statutory procedures for commission proceedings.

headings.title: Retention of commission jurisdiction for supplemental orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to retain jurisdiction to issue supplemental orders, modify terms, or revoke permits for noncompliance with safety rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5389, A.L. 1979 H.B. 186). Confirmed draft titles for PSC safety/interference/duplication jurisdiction, standard proceedings/review, and retained jurisdiction for supplemental orders.

headings.title: Application of revenues and distribution of patronage refunds
headings.reviewNote: Requires revenues exceeding operating costs, debt service, construction, working capital, and education funds to be distributed as patronage refunds.

headings.title: Authority for prepayment of cooperative indebtedness
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that provisions do not prohibit cooperative from paying all or part of its indebtedness prior to maturity.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5405). Confirmed draft titles for cooperative revenue application/patronage refunds and debt prepayment authority.

headings.title: Member approval required for property sale or lease
headings.reviewNote: Requires two-thirds member vote at noticed meeting to sell, lease, or dispose of all or substantial portion of cooperative property.

headings.title: Board authority to mortgage or encumber property to secure debt
headings.reviewNote: Empowers board of directors without member approval to mortgage or pledge cooperative assets and revenues to secure federal or institutional financing.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5406, A.L. 1971 H.B. 126). Confirmed draft titles for two-thirds member approval of property sales/leases and board authority to mortgage/encumber assets without member vote.

headings.title: Extension of lines and process agent designation for foreign cooperatives
headings.reviewNote: Exempts foreign rural electric cooperatives in adjacent states from general foreign corporation qualification upon designating secretary of state process agent.

headings.title: Forwarding of service of process by secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Requires secretary of state to forward served process by registered mail to foreign cooperative at specified address.

headings.title: Standing to sue and be sued
headings.reviewNote: Grants foreign cooperative standing to sue and be sued in Missouri courts to same extent as domestic cooperatives.

headings.title: Authority to mortgage and encumber in-state property
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes foreign cooperative to secure indebtedness by mortgage or encumbrance on in-state assets, franchises, and revenues.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5411). Confirmed all 4 draft titles for adjacent-state cooperatives extending lines, secretary of state process forwarding, standing to sue/be sued, and in-state mortgaging.

headings.title: Voluntary dissolution prior to commencement of business
headings.reviewNote: Establishes procedure for voluntary dissolution by majority of incorporators before commencing business upon refunding fees and clearing debts.

headings.title: Filing articles of dissolution with secretary of state
headings.reviewNote: Directs submission of pre-commencement articles of dissolution to secretary of state for filing.

headings.title: Procedure for voluntary dissolution after commencing business
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth post-commencement dissolution procedure: member vote, certificate of election, creditor notice, winding up, asset distribution, and final articles.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5403). Confirmed all 3 draft titles for pre-commencement voluntary dissolution, filing articles, and post-commencement dissolution/winding up.

headings.title: Schedule of filing fees for corporate documents
headings.reviewNote: Establishes statutory fee schedule for filing articles of incorporation, amendments, mergers, conversions, dissolutions, and office changes.

headings.title: Payment and collection of fees by director of revenue
headings.reviewNote: Directs that all mandated fees be made payable to and collected by the state director of revenue.

headings.title: Fee waiver for military and National Guard members
headings.reviewNote: Waives articles of incorporation filing fee if an initial member is active duty military or Missouri National Guard residing in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5412, A.L. 1947 V. I p. 232, A.L. 2014 S.B. 600). Confirmed all 3 draft titles for filing fee schedule, director of revenue collection, and active-duty military/National Guard incorporation fee waiver.

headings.title: Written waiver of notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides that written waiver signed before or after the designated time is equivalent to required statutory, charter, or bylaw notice.

headings.title: Waiver of meeting notice through attendance
headings.reviewNote: Treats attendance at a meeting as waiver of notice unless attendance is solely to object to unlawfulness of call or convention.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5409). Confirmed draft titles for written waiver of notice and meeting attendance waiver exception.

headings.title: Displacement of retail electric competition by territorial agreements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes displacement of retail electric competition among cooperatives, electrical corporations, and municipal utilities via territorial agreements.

headings.title: Required boundary designations and extraterritorial operating authority
headings.reviewNote: Mandates specific boundary designations, cooperative municipal operating powers, and municipal extraterritorial operating powers in agreements.

headings.title: Petition to commission to designate disputed service area boundaries
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes joint petition to public service commission to establish binding service area boundaries based on public interest.

headings.title: Commission approval requirement for territorial agreements
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission report and order approving territorial agreements, amendments, or assignments, generally within 120 days of application.

headings.title: Evidentiary hearings and public interest determination
headings.reviewNote: Mandates evidentiary hearings on territorial agreements unless waived by unanimous stipulation, authorizing approval if not detrimental to public interest.

headings.title: Preservation of non-party and authorized electrical corporation rights
headings.reviewNote: Provides agreement approval does not affect non-party rights and commission shall disregard agreement when evaluating non-party service requests.

headings.title: Commission complaint jurisdiction, hearing, and revocation authority
headings.reviewNote: Grants commission jurisdiction to hear complaints, hold hearings, and suspend or revoke agreements no longer in public interest, limiting broader utility jurisdiction.

headings.title: Assessment of commission review fees and deposit in public service fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs commission to establish fee schedule for review costs assessed to parties and credited to public service commission fund.

headings.title: Commission authority to hold hearings on own motion
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to hold a hearing regarding any application, complaint, or petition under this section upon its own motion.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 9 subsections and source notes (L. 1988 S.B. 689, A.L. 1989 H.B. 813, A.L. 2007 S.B. 416; § 416.041 antitrust cross-ref). Confirmed all 9 draft titles covering territorial agreements, boundary petitions, 120-day PSC approval, hearings, non-party rights, complaints, fees, and own-motion hearings.

headings.title: Definitions of permanent service and structure
headings.reviewNote: Defines permanent service facilities versus temporary construction service, and defines structure, additions, and tract limitations.

headings.title: Right to continue permanent service and commission change orders
headings.reviewNote: Vests right to continue serving structure, restricts competitor service absent annexation or agreement, and limits commission change orders to non-rate public interest.

headings.title: Permanent service rights for demolished and replaced structures
headings.reviewNote: Allows retail supplier in area no longer rural to provide permanent service to replacement structure upon owner request following demolition; footnote notes 'section' appears in original rolls of H.B. 271 and H.B. 734 (2021).

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 1982 H.B. 1646 § 2 through A.L. 2021 H.B. 271/H.B. 734/S.B. 44; original-rolls footnote 'section' in sub 3; § 386.805 cross-ref). Confirmed all 3 draft titles and added original-rolls footnote to sub 3 note.
